import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class SwiGLUFFN(nn.Module):

    def __init__(
        self,
        input_dim,
        hidden_dim
    ):

        super().__init__()

        self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(
            input_dim,
            hidden_dim,
            bias=False
        )

        self.up_proj = nn.Linear(
            input_dim,
            hidden_dim,
            bias=False
        )

        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(
            hidden_dim,
            input_dim,
            bias=False
        )

        self.silu = nn.SiLU()

    def forward(self, x):

        gate = self.silu(
            self.gate_proj(x)
        )

        value = self.up_proj(x)

        x = gate * value

        return self.down_proj(x)

model = SwiGLUFFN(
    input_dim=4,
    hidden_dim=16
)
x = torch.randn(8, 4)

output = model(x)

print(output.shape)
